title: Kiln seat
description: Written by the launcher before a seat starts; read by the hooks and the team tool. A session without a seat.json matching its pane env is not a Kiln seat and every hook exits 0 at once.

address.description: Ledger address. Persistent seats: tab or role word (director, super, helper, research, plan, build, verify, deploy, council, build-chunkmaster). Workers: <tab>-<task>-<kind>[-fix<n>].

name.description: Display name chosen by the boss (cosmetic; pane label only). Chunk Master and Gravedigger are fixed.

tab.description: Herdr tab the seat lives in (bridge, research, plan, build, verify, deploy, council).

root.description: Writable root. Managers: their phase folder. Workers: their worktree; the run folder is listed in extra_roots.

inbox.description: Path of the seat's inbox marker file. Workers have none (empty string): nobody writes to a worker.

parent.description: Address of the launcher. Empty for the director.

lane.description: routing.toml lane the model came from.

handoff.description: Path of the seat's handoff file (persistent seats only).

card.description: Path of the role card injected at SessionStart (persistent seats only).

pane.description: Herdr pane id, as HERDR_PANE_ID in the pane env; the hooks match it.

wait_ms.description: Herdr wait timeout in milliseconds, supplied by --wait-ms.

run.description: Worker-specific status/run folder, from --run; persistent seats use their phase root. Status is read only here.
